layers.name: Example FlatGeobuf Layer
layers._comment: flatgeobuf: native MapLibre rendering with viewport-bbox HTTP Range reads against the file's spatial index (write the .fgb with an index, see data/convert-geojson-to-flatgeobuf.py). Below `minzoom` (default 12) nothing is fetched or shown. The server must send Accept-Ranges: bytes and CORS-expose Content-Range. Not chart/statistics/area-filter eligible (like mvt); geometryType picks the flat-style layer type (point=circle, line=line, polygon=fill).
